prose.favour: The case in its favour rests mostly on the recent price trend: momentum scores 65 of 100 against the comparison pool. Also in its favour: the share price is 28.3% higher than a year ago; over the past year the share did 30.5 percentage points better than the Nifty 50; and the share price is close to its 52-week high. Other areas on this side: growth, what the price asks for the earnings, risk.
prose.against: The case against rests mostly on the balance sheet: profit covers interest costs only 2.4 times; 3 or more is more comfortable. Also against it: debt is as large as or larger than shareholders' equity (debt-to-equity 2.92); quality scores only 20 of 100 against the comparison pool; and 63% of the promoters' shares are pledged as loan security, a risk flag. Other areas on this side: the quality of the business, who owns the company, price behaviour.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 9 points in favour and 5 against give more points in favour. The pool score is 50 of 100. The side that carries most weight is the recent price trend. That gives an educational rating of Hold with medium confidence. This is a rule-based reading of the evidence above, not a prediction.
